gitCommit.subject: feat: async route params + falsifiable test oracle, atomically on Next 14 (purses-9oxh.3) (#330)
gitCommit.body:
feat: async route params + falsifiable test oracle, atomically on Next 14 (purses-9oxh.3) (#330)

* docs: correct the deps handoff — it was wrong in two load-bearing places

The handoff told the next agent to close purses-mebk (which has three open
children, forbidden by CLAUDE.md's definition of done) and prescribed a fix
for 9oxh.3 that would 404 every dynamic route in production: routes read
params.id synchronously, so handing them a real Promise yields undefined.

- §0 (new): this doc is leads, not facts. CLAUDE.md / bd show / graphify are
  the sources of truth; verify against them before acting.
- §1: #329 is merged. Do NOT close purses-mebk — three children still open.
- §5: the corrected 9oxh.3 design. Route async-params migration and oracle
  hardening are ONE atomic change — (b) alone mass-404s, (a) alone leaves an
  oracle that cannot fail. Next 14.2.35 builds clean with a Promise params
  signature (verified by an actual build), so both land before the Next bump.
- §3/§6: drop the stale prod Neon hostname; note auto-merge is disabled and
  that Conservative profile means a doc cannot authorize a merge.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01CFBKAkT5Z2b8uamK46Yepa

* docs: design spec for epic purses-9oxh (get on latest, every major dep)

Seven serial PRs: oracle+routes atomic (.3), Node truth (.1), Next 14->16
holding React 18 (.4), React 19 (.2), zod 4 (.5), tailwind 4 (.6), tooling
(.7). Verification-first: full-surface build proof for async params, exact
route-count oracle, rejects-still-reject for zod, screenshot+axe for tailwind.

Corrects PR #329's false zod-scope claim: the surface is 19 non-test files
(incl. env.ts at module load and three client forms), not 7. Bead 9oxh.5
updated to match.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01CFBKAkT5Z2b8uamK46Yepa

* docs(spec): fold adversarial review round 1 into the deps-latest epic spec

Three personas (QA/Test, Architect, Security), all CONCERNS, no BLOCK.
Falsifiability re-attributed to owner-2xx suites + e2e + PR-3 typegen (the
stranger enum accepts 404 and cannot fail on a params mistake). Oracle
integrity upgraded to key-set snapshot + frozen allowlist/predicate +
diff-shape rule + test-side exhaustiveness gate. Surface corrected 39->51
files; page oracle routed to PR 3; middleware->proxy added; auth:verify
found running nowhere automatically (PR 1 adds it to CI); TS 7 re-scoped
to 6.0.x on the typescript-eslint peer wall; revertability corrected to
LIFO; zod pins named as net-new plus one tautological pin to convert.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01CFBKAkT5Z2b8uamK46Yepa

* docs(spec): fold ponytail/YAGNI review round 2 — 6 PRs, demote one-time checks

Key-set snapshot and test-side exhaustiveness gate demoted from permanent
tests to PR-body evidence re-run at PR 3; 19-file zod inventory test demoted
to PR-body grep; client-form zod pins cut (server mirrors are the guard);
PR 2 (Node truth) folded into PR 7 saving a CI run (owner confirmed the
July restraint). Reversed one demotion against the artifacts: ulid ordering
assertion stays permanent — compareByCreatedAtThenId() ties decision
ordering on id. All round-1 authz protections retained.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01CFBKAkT5Z2b8uamK46Yepa
